Print auxiliary-model and test results

print.latentmix_aux.Rd

Print methods for the results of r3step(), bch(), dcat(), lmr(), blrt() and compare_models(): a titled console summary with the estimates and tests. Use lm_table() for publication tables of the same results.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'latentmix_aux'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latentmix_r3step'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latentmix_bch'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latentmix_dcat'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latentmix_lmr'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latentmix_blrt'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latentmix_compare'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latentmix_comparison'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

Arguments

x

A result of r3step(), bch(), dcat(), lmr(), blrt() or compare_models() (classes latentmix_r3step, latentmix_bch, latentmix_dcat, latentmix_lmr, latentmix_blrt, latentmix_compare, latentmix_comparison), or any other latentmix_aux object (printed through its Julia text).

...

Ignored.

digits

Number of decimal places.

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

lm_table()

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
# printed results of the LMR test and a BCH model for the ACE classes
m <- lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 4)     # 4 ACE classes, as generated
#> Starting Julia ...
print(lmr(m))                             # 4 against 3 classes
#> ━━ Vuong-Lo-Mendell-Rubin test: 3 vs. 4 classes ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
#>   H0 log-likelihood (K - 1 classes)  -5316.153
#>   2 × LL difference                    136.292
#>   Difference in parameters                   9
#>   VLMR p                                <0.001
#>   Adjusted LMR LRT                     134.253
#>   Adjusted LMR p                        <0.001
print(bch(m, aces, depress), digits = 2)  # depressive symptoms by class
#> ━━ BCH: distal outcome depress by class ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
#>   n = 1453 (47 rows with missing outcome excluded)

#>   1       4.76  0.14     12.10
#>   2      10.26  0.30     12.93
#>   3       6.99  0.32      7.30
#>   4      13.80  0.44     12.51
#>   ────────────────────────────
#> 
#> ── Wald tests of equal means ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────
#>   Test           Chi-square  df       p

#>   Class 1 vs. 4     392.337   1  <0.001
#>   Class 2 vs. 3      51.616   1  <0.001

#>   Class 3 vs. 4     143.694   1  <0.001
